# regstat

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/mtloots/regstat/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/mtloots/regstat/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

An **exact, covariance-free test** for a change in covariance structure. The likelihood-ratio
null does not depend on the unknown common covariance, so one calibration serves every covariance.

Computation runs on a shared pure-C back-end that is also bound from Python, and the two front
ends are checked against each other value by value.

## Installation

```r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("mtloots/regstat", subdir = "regstat")
```

## Usage

```{r example}
library(regstat)
set.seed(1)
XA <- matrix(rnorm(180), 60, 3)
XB <- matrix(rnorm(150), 50, 3) %*% diag(c(1, 1.6, 0.7))
c(same = cov_M(XA, XA), different = cov_M(XA, XB))
cov_test(XA, XB, method = "exact")$p.value
```
